item.title: Tagalog Lullabies for Babies to Sleep | 1 Hour Calm Music Box & Rain (20 Nov 2026)
item.description:
Gentle 1-hour bedtime lullabies on soft music box, celesta, harp and piano with calm rain, to help babies and toddlers drift off to sleep, with Kuya Koala!
Tonight's bedtime Tagalog words (first 10 minutes): • Duyan = Hammock / cradle • Tahimik = Quiet • Mahal kita = I love you
Tracklist: 00:00 Hangin sa Gabi 07:34 Brahms' Lullaby (Hele ni Brahms) 15:04 Ilaw ng Buwan 22:39 Kumot at Unan 30:13 Twinkle Twinkle Little Star (Kislap, Kislap, Munting Bituin) 37:47 Duyan sa Puno 45:22 Tahimik na Gabi 52:56 Antok na si Koala
Made for healthy sleep: a dim, warm night scene with no flashing and no sudden loud sounds, a slow 55–65 BPM pace, and the screen gets darker after 15 minutes.
Music: original Kuya Koala lullabies plus traditional public-domain melodies, arranged and synthesised by Kuya Koala & Friends.
Watch the video version on YouTube: https://youtu.be/rpZwv-HYloc
